description: Refuse COMPLETED without a receipt. Add to your Claude Code settings hooks or load via the plugin.

hooks.command: bash -c 'if grep -qiE "status[\" :=]+(COMPLETED|DONE|COMPLETE)\b" <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" && ! grep -qiE "receipt" <<< "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT"; then echo "receipted-operator: refusing COMPLETED without a receipt field" >&2; exit 2; fi'
